migration.description: Add the per-consumer PostgreSQL analytics ingest receipt and its versioned owner-applied ledger step.
migration.release_unit_description: C3 analytics-module continuous consumption and idempotent receive.

durable_state.description: A receipt binds source_instance_id and event_id to generation, change_id, identity, operation, payload_digest, and the canonical payload; a pending projection work item survives source acknowledgement and restart.
durable_state.storage_implementation: PostgreSQL cvm_analytics.analytics_module_ingest_receipts and analytics_module_ingest_work plus analytics_module_ddl_ledger component analytics-module-ingest.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: C2 module schema version 1 with legacy pg-analytics schema version 1

ddl_structural_changes.description: Create the receipt/work tables, cursor indexes, and maintenance-role grants through the owner-only migration API.

dml_changes.description: Persist the applying/applied/failed ledger state and enqueue one durable projection work item per accepted event; no historical receipt backfill is performed.

pause_points: after module DDL and before ingest DDL
after ingest migration commit and before actor startup

required_test_evidence: not applicable: additive durable state is classified minor
C2 module ledger is required before C3 migration
failed or interrupted applying state re-enters forward
real PostgreSQL role and interruption validation is not_run until the task-owned Agent VM fixture is available
not applicable: direct major skips are unsupported

validation.status: candidate implementation; real PostgreSQL migration, interruption, and role evidence not_run
